title: Optimize OBS Studio
name: optimize-obs
modal: OBS will be closed to apply this. Use a hardware encoder (NVENC/AMF/QuickSync) in OBS output settings for the biggest gain, this script cannot change that.
description: Raises OBS process priority, disables preview rendering and clears old logs to stop encoding overload
deepDescription:
This changes OBS Studio for better recording and streaming performance:

- Process priority → High (Windows reserves CPU for OBS)
- Preview rendering → Off in every scene collection (frees GPU)
- Logs older than 30 days → Deleted

Do manually in OBS for full effect: hardware encoder, output 720p60 or 1080p60, run OBS as administrator.
